title: Resting ECG context for exercise ST depression: uncertain incremental prediction across two angiography centers
abstract: Adding abnormal-resting-ECG × exercise-ST-depression to standard additive predictors in Cleveland-to-Hungary angiography transport (303 source,269 target) changed Brier error by -0.002493 (joint bootstrap95% [-0.011343,0.006351]); benefit was not established and abnormal-ECG target predictions worsened.
